requirement:
Only records whose captured source inputs match the current project source and
whose build configurations are compatible MAY contribute execution counts to
the combined view of {cite}`requirements.test-coverage.index.selection`.
Records invalidated by a source change, or whose compatibility cannot be
established, MUST be identified as stale or unavailable and excluded from the
combined coverage totals. Their per-process reports and matching captured source
MUST remain retained in the build artifacts until those artifacts are removed.
rationale:
The reviewed tests adequately check `requirements.test-coverage.index.freshness`. Each obligation maps to at least one marked test with assertions.

**Only fresh, compatible records contribute.**
- `src/execution_coverage/book.rs#mod[tests]/fn[filtered_runs_union_latest_attempts_and_invalidate_with_saved_source]` first shows `2/2 (100.0%)` for fresh records. After `code.rs` changes, it asserts "gap counts unavailable" and "stale coverage; recollect".
- The same test records a newer attempt under a different build configuration (`build-b`). It then asserts "historical build configuration", `1/1 (100.0%)` and "1 selected test attempts". So records from the other configuration are excluded from the totals.
- `src/execution_coverage.rs#mod[tests]/fn[source_and_build_inputs_invalidate_on_addition_removal_and_dirty_content]` exercises `fresh` directly. It asserts staleness for a modified source file, an added source file, a removed source file, and changed, added or removed `Cargo.toml`, `Cargo.lock` and `rust-toolchain.toml`. It also covers new files in watched input directories, a watched path that did not exist when captured, and a dirty working tree with an unchanged revision. It asserts freshness again after each restore.
- `src/execution_coverage/book.rs#mod[tests]/fn[cargo_launch_metadata_does_not_invalidate_but_caller_build_environment_does]` shows that Cargo-supplied package metadata keeps a record fresh. It also shows that changes to `CC`, `RUSTFLAGS`, `CARGO_PROFILE_*`, `CARGO_TARGET_*_LINKER` and a user build variable make it stale.
- `tests/execution_coverage.rs#fn[real_build_captures_dependency_files_and_environment_for_read_only_freshness_checks]` uses a real build. It checks that `include_str!` files, `build.rs`, `Cargo.lock` and `rerun-if-changed` inputs are captured, along with compile-time and build-script environment variables. Changing any of them makes the rendered book report "1 stale test attempts".

**Stale or unavailable records are identified and excluded.**
- `src/execution_coverage/book.rs#mod[tests]/fn[incomplete_attempts_do_not_label_their_files_as_unmeasured_in_a_partial_map]` covers a fresh record alongside an unavailable one, and then alongside a stale one. It asserts "1 unavailable test attempts" and "1 stale test attempts". It also asserts that no per-file map is shown, so the unavailable record does not produce partial totals.
- `src/execution_coverage/book.rs#mod[tests]/fn[unreadable_history_cannot_reintroduce_an_older_success]` covers each way compatibility or availability cannot be established:
  - an unreadable newest attempt;
  - missing captured source ("Matching captured source is missing");
  - unsupported schema 99 ("Coverage history is incomplete");
  - a missing raw profile ("A retained raw profile is missing").
  
  Each case asserts "gap counts unavailable", and the first asserts the old `1/1 (100.0%)` is not reintroduced.

**Reports and captured source stay retained.**
- In `filtered_runs_union_latest_attempts_and_invalidate_with_saved_source`, `load_saved` still returns every record after the source change. Each record's `run.sources["code.rs"]` still contains the original `fn one() {}`.
- The real-build test asserts `retained_files(&storage) == before` after the stale renders. That covers the retained per-process reports and profiles after the stale renders.

**Gaps.** The stale-selected-plus-fresh-selected mix is only asserted through "unavailable" and "stale" indicators and the absence of the per-file map. Stale totals are never directly asserted absent. The source also suggests the implementation withholds all totals in that case. That is an acceptable reading of "excluded from the combined totals", and I did not treat it as a gap.

text: :::{req} index.freshness
Only records whose captured source inputs match the current project source and
whose build configurations are compatible MAY contribute execution counts to
the combined view of {cite}`requirements.test-coverage.index.selection`.
Records invalidated by a source change, or whose compatibility cannot be
established, MUST be identified as stale or unavailable and excluded from the
combined coverage totals. Their per-process reports and matching captured source
MUST remain retained in the build artifacts until those artifacts are removed.
:::{req} index.selection
The coverage index MUST combine the most recent recorded test attempt for each
nextest binary and test name among the retained runs. "Most recent" MUST refer
to when the attempt started, including failed or interrupted attempts. A newer
filtered run MUST update only the tests it executes, leaving other compatible
test records available to the combined view. A newer attempt with missing or
unreadable coverage MUST be shown as unavailable rather than replaced with an
older successful attempt. Results from incompatible instrumented build
configurations MUST NOT be combined under
{cite}`requirements.test-coverage.storage.configuration`.
The main combined view MUST use the instrumented build configuration of the
most recently started recorded test attempt. Latest-per-test selection MUST
occur within that configuration. Records from other configurations MUST be
identified as excluded historical coverage. Configuration selection MUST use
recorded metadata without building or executing tests.
